QuestInfo.name: Voice of Warning
QuestInfo.1: Shiba takes offense at how the Cygnus Knights look down on the Dual Blades. You should warn them not to provoke the Blades, or Shiba might attack Ereve on his own. Speak with the tactician of the Cygnus Knights, #bNeinheart#k.
QuestInfo.2: Shiba took offense at how the Cygnus Knights look down on the Dual Blades. To prevent Shiba from going to attack Ereve on his own, you warned the tactician of the Cygnus Knights, #bNeinheart#k, not to provke the Dual Blades.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 200\nUnlocks the Dual Blade's Steps quest\n

0.0: Hey! #h0#! Did you hear? The Cygnus Knights sent someone to check on Lady Syl 'cause they don't trust us! Can you believe it? After we agreed to help them, how dare they doubt us?! I won't stand for this! I'll go to Ereve myself and teach 'em a lesson!\r\n#L0##bWait! Calm down! Lady Syl wants us to look past it. Besides, it doesn't help anyone but the Black Mage if we start infighting.#l\n#k
0.1: Well... When you put it that way... No, I can't just ignore this insult!\r\n#L0##bLet me take care of it. I'll straighten them out. You stay here and...help Lady Syl keep things in order.#l\n#k
0.2: Well...okay. You show them we Dual Blades can't be messed with! Got it?

no.0: Fine, I'll go myself, teach them a thing or two about respect!

1.0: What brings the Dual Blades here today?\r\n#L0##bI come bearing a warning.#l\n#k
1.1: A warning... Just what are you saying? Is it wise to burst into Ereve and make such rude accusations?\r\n#L0##bYou're the rude ones. We joined the Maple Alliance through legitimate means. We're your allies, but you continue to send spies to watch our every movement? You may not fully trust us yet, but we will not tolerate any more insults to Lady Syl's honor.#l\n#k
1.2: This must be an understanding. We simply wanted some assurance of our new ally's sincerity. As you yourself said, we're working towards a common cause now. I say, let's leave our misgivings behind us, yes?\r\n#L0##bI'm glad to hear that we're in agreement. Let's try to be a bit more respectful of each other in the future. Believe me, you want the Dual Blades on your side.#l\n#k
1.3: Very well. We will continue to...look out for each other. Have a pleasant journey home.

npc.0: You show them we Dual Blades can't be messed with! Got it?
